name: Font
description: Contains the font attributes (font name, font size, color, and so on) for an object.
remarks: If you don't want to format all the text in a cell or graphic the same way, use the Characters property of the Range object to return a subset of the text.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Background
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of background for text used in charts. Read/write Variant, which is set to one of the constants of XlBackground.

properties.name: Bold
properties.description: True if the font is bold. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns or sets the primary color of the object, as shown in the table in the remarks section. Use the RGB function to create a color value. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the color of the font.

properties.name: FontStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the font style. Read/write String.

properties.name: Italic
properties.description: True if the font style is italic. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Size
properties.description: Returns or sets the size of the font. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Strikethrough
properties.description: True if the font is struck through with a horizontal line. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Subscript
properties.description: True if the font is formatted as subscript. False by default. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Superscript
properties.description: True if the font is formatted as superscript; False by default. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Underline
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of underline applied to the font. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ThemeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the theme color in the applied color scheme that is associated with the specified object. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: TintAndShade
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that lightens or darkens a color.

properties.name: ThemeFont
properties.description: Returns or sets the theme font in the applied font scheme that is associated with the specified object. Read/write XlThemeFont.
